cn.app.name: 特技摩托前线 · 后台
cn.login.title: 后台登录
cn.login.hint: 这里是服务器管理员入口，不是游戏账号。
cn.login.resetHint: 口令在服务器第一次启动时打印在控制台上。忘了可以运行 python tf_server.py --reset-admin 重设。
cn.accounts.title: 账号
cn.accounts.lead: 玩家账号、设备槽与登录会话。设备槽是独立身份，profileId 与账号不同，别混着看。
cn.accounts.register.title: 玩家注册入口
cn.accounts.register.lead: 这两条地址给玩家用手机浏览器打开就行，不需要管理员登录。游戏里注册走的是同一个接口，所以一般用不到——需要给新玩家开号时把上面那条发给他。
cn.accounts.sessions.title: 登录会话
cn.accounts.sessions.lead: 客户端每次冷启动都会新签一张票据，所以这里通常很多。清掉不会让玩家退出登录（长期凭据在 remember.json，不受影响）。
cn.accounts.sessions.cleared: 已清掉 {n} 张会话票据
cn.accounts.sessions.confirmBody: 会删掉当前 {n} 张票据。玩家不会被踢出登录状态，但正在进行的请求会失败并重试。
cn.accounts.deleteConfirmBody: 账号记录会被删除。存档目录会保留在磁盘上（可以之后再接回来），但游戏里将无法再用这个账号登录。此操作不可撤销。
cn.accounts.devices.title: 设备槽
cn.accounts.devices.lead: 设备按 deviceId 建档，走的是另一套 profileId。
cn.accounts.admin.title: 管理员口令
cn.accounts.admin.lead: 改完会立刻踢掉所有其它设备上的后台登录，当前这一张自动续期。
cn.saves.title: 存档
cn.saves.lead: 服务器上落盘的 playerprogress。richness 是「内容丰富度」，也是防清档护栏的判据：写入时 richness 减半或段落丢失就会被拒绝。
cn.saves.item135: 道具 135（存档侧，不是竞技场金票）
cn.saves.richnessHint: richness = 物品对数 + 赛道记录 + 成就 + 教学 + missions/statistics 加成。它变小通常意味着有一半存档没上报。
cn.saves.versionHint: 下发物品靠的就是把它 +1：客户端看到 remote ≠ local 才会弹进度冲突，让玩家选「用云端」。
cn.saves.historyLead: 回滚会把快照提回 latest.json。回滚前会自动埋一个恢复点，所以回滚本身也能撤销。
cn.saves.rollbackConfirmBody: 当前 latest.json（richness {rich}）会被这一份（richness {new}）替换。回滚前会自动存一份现场，可以在随后弹出的提示里撤销。
cn.saves.noHistory: 这个存档槽还没有历史快照。
cn.saves.noBalances: 这个存档里没有读得懂的 items2。
cn.grant.title: 下发物品
cn.grant.lead: 下发分两类：竞技场余额（金票、筹码）的真源在服务器上，改完玩家下次打开竞技场就看到了，不需要任何操作；存档物品要改存档文件，而且必须玩家在游戏里选「用云端」才收得到。
cn.grant.saveTitle: 存档物品 · 需要玩家选「用云端」
cn.grant.list.unverified: 未验证：这几类的存档写法没在真机上确认过，id 又与零件共用一段键空间，写下去不保证生效。
cn.grant.whitelist: 清单来自游戏自带的物品表（477 条：货币 / 消耗品 / 零件 / 服装 / 蓝图 / 赛道，涂装单独一卡）。货币、消耗品、零件在存档里是计数器（「增加 N」就是 +N）；服装按套装列出，勾一套 = 头盔 / 上衣 / 裤装一起解锁；服装部件和蓝图是 0/1 标志，不能给数量。赛道类没有真机证据，卡片里标了「未验证」。PVP 金票在存档里没有对应项，请用上面的竞技场卡。
cn.grant.list.derived: 服装按套装列出（80 套，数据来自游戏自带的套装表）：勾一套 = 头盔 / 上衣 / 裤装三件一起解锁。带「隐藏」标记的套装没上架过，它的部件编号在任何配置里都不出现，是按套装表推出来的。
cn.grant.list.paintHint: 涂装按「车」分组列出（108 款，数据来自游戏自带的 bikes.txt）：存档里每辆车只有一条记录，低 24 位是「这辆车每一款涂装有没有」的位掩码，高 8 位是当前装备的那一款。勾一款就是把那一位置 1 —— 涂装自己的编号不会进存档。
cn.grant.list.bpHint: 蓝图是碎片计数器，按车列出（19 辆车里 12 辆有碎片编号，数据来自游戏自带的 upgrades.txt）：每辆车要的片数不同，勾一下默认填「还差几片」。另外 7 辆（{names}）没有碎片编号，只能金币买，不是漏掉。
cn.grant.modeHint: 增加/设为只作用于计数类（货币、消耗品、零件）
cn.grant.pvpTitle: 竞技场 · 服务端即时生效
cn.grant.pvpLead: 金票和筹码的真源是服务器的 pvp_state.json。客户端只会发「扣一张」「加 N 张」这种增减指令，从不整份上报余额，所以这里改完立刻生效、也不会被覆盖。
cn.grant.pvpPlace: pvp_state.json · players.<存档槽>.golden_ticket / chips.<存档槽>.chips
cn.grant.pvpDone: 竞技场已更新：{summary}（立刻生效）
cn.grant.pvpNever: 这个存档槽还没有竞技场排名记录，金票按服务端默认值起算。
cn.grant.warnTitle: 改存档不足以让客户端接受它
cn.grant.warnBody: 我们会把存档 version +1。客户端下次同步时发现和本地版本不一致，会弹进度冲突界面 —— 玩家选「用云端」才会真的拿到物品，选「用本机」会把服务器的下发覆盖掉。所以这不是即点即得，请告诉玩家该点哪个。
cn.grant.warnBody2: 真机实测过：客户端冷启动时会先问服务器版本号，然后仍然直接把自己的本地档推上来，根本不弹冲突界面，下发当场就被抹掉。所以存档下发不保证送达。金票和筹码请用上面的竞技场卡。
cn.grant.noSave: 这个存档槽读不出来，换个槽试试
cn.grant.zero: 数量填 0 什么也不会发生
cn.msg.authRequired: 需要管理员登录，正在跳回登录页…
cn.weekly.lead: 午夜杯是每周一次的计时赛：玩家在一条赛道上跑一次，服务器按成绩排名发奖。这一屏改的是服务端 weekly 段，保存立刻生效，玩家不用做任何事，也不用重启服务。
cn.weekly.now.title: 现状
cn.weekly.now.warn: 玩家的挑战次数只存在服务器内存里：服务一重启，所有人本周的次数就回到满值。要真正重置一届，用下面的「立刻结束本届」。
cn.weekly.now.noPlayers: 这一届还没有玩家打过。
cn.weekly.f.daysHint: 改完窗口长度，周号会跟着变，玩家本周次数重新开始。
cn.weekly.f.offsetHint: 按服务器真实周校准。想让这一届立刻结束，用下面的红按钮。
cn.weekly.time.title: 时间
cn.weekly.time.hint: 午夜杯没有对局时长 —— 玩家跑一次计时赛就完，时长在客户端原表里。
cn.weekly.time.resetBody: 所有人的本周挑战次数会立刻归零、榜单从下周重新开始（当前成绩不会发奖）。确定吗？
cn.weekly.time.resetHint: 等价于把周号往前推一周。撤销在改动记录里，一条条撤即可。
cn.weekly.rules.title: 挑战规则
cn.weekly.rules.retryHint: 每个玩家每周能跑几次，用完了就得等冷却。
cn.weekly.rules.note: 注意：午夜杯的赛道计时（多久算超时、跑几圈）写死在客户端原表里，服务端改不了，这里也不显示。
cn.weekly.track.title: 赛道与对手
cn.weekly.track.unknown: 客户端原表里没有这个编号，请核对。
cn.weekly.track.noCatalog: 服务端目录里还没有赛道表，只能手填编号。
cn.weekly.track.fakeHint: 补几个合成对手，让榜单看起来有人。0 = 只有真人。当前：
cn.weekly.track.pctHint: 相对基准成绩的浮动比例。
cn.weekly.track.note: 赛道编号和榜单编号都来自客户端原表（原表里没有的编号，客户端会直接崩或空榜）。改完让玩家退出午夜杯再进。
cn.weekly.rewards.title: 奖励
cn.weekly.rewards.builtin: 未指定 → 走内置规则
cn.weekly.rewards.how: 服务端只下发「池子编号」（1–15），池子里到底装什么由客户端的奖励表决定。点方块选中，同一档位可以选多个（会依次发）。
cn.weekly.rewards.reentry: ★ 客户端只在进入午夜杯时读一次奖励配置：改完要让玩家退出午夜杯再进，不用重启游戏。
cn.weekly.templates.title: 模板
cn.weekly.templates.currentHint: 只读。存模板就是把这整页参数拍个快照，存到服务端。
cn.weekly.templates.name: 模板名
cn.weekly.templates.nameHint: 例如：新手周 / 高难周
cn.weekly.templates.saveHint: 存的是此刻生效的值，不是上面还没保存的改动。
cn.weekly.templates.deleteBody: 删除模板「{name}」？删了就找不回来了。
cn.bunker.lead: 碉堡是天梯排位：赛季按天数自动换届，名次越高奖励越好。这一屏管服务端的赛季、对局时长、匹配、筹码与赛季奖励，保存立刻生效，玩家不用做任何事。段位/星章/金票只在「现状」卡里看，要改玩家余额请用「下发物品」页的竞技场卡。
cn.bunker.now.noMatches: 当前没有进行中的对局。
cn.bunker.now.noQueue: 队列是空的，也没有人在线。
cn.bunker.advanceHint: 按一次 = 本届窗口整体往前挪一轮：玩家下次进碉堡时按旧届结算并复位段位。客户端看到的编号不变（要改那个用上面的「显示编号偏移」）。撤销在改动记录里。
cn.bunker.advanceBody: 本届会立刻到期：玩家下次进碉堡就会按旧届结算赛季奖励并把段位复位。窗口和内部届号都不变，只是整体挪了一轮。可以撤销。确定吗？
cn.bunker.advanceDone: 已推进到下一赛季（推进计数 {n}）
cn.bunker.pipeWarn: 不能含竖线 | —— 客户端只显示第一个 | 之后的内容。
cn.bunker.stars.hint: 第 1 格 = rank 1（最高），第 25 格 = 最低；每格 0..100。改完只影响之后的晋级判定。
cn.bunker.track.empty: 服务端目录里还没有赛道表（items.json 的 levels 段），只能手填编号，用逗号隔开。
cn.bunker.rewards.special: 特殊奖励（下拉或填编号）
cn.bunker.rewards.unknown: 客户端不认识这个编号：会发成一个占位物（毛驴轮胎）
cn.bunker.rewards.subtitle: 数量是「这一档的增量」：客户端会把该名次及以上的档位累加起来发。金币 = item 1、钻石 = item 2、特殊奖励 = item 145（它那一格填的是客户端原表里的 RewardID）。特殊奖励只认原表 PVPMatchSpecialRewards 里的 43 个编号：零件 4 档 + 两款涂装（202 / 203）+ 毛驴图纸（220）。喷漆、衣服、赛道都发不了，要发请用「下发物品」页。
cn.bunker.products.title: 礼包（商城商品）

en.app.name: Trials Frontier · Admin
en.login.title: Admin sign-in
en.login.hint: This is the server operator console, not a game account.
en.login.resetHint: The password is printed on the server console the first time it starts. Lost it? Run python tf_server.py --reset-admin.
en.accounts.title: Accounts
en.accounts.lead: Player accounts, device slots and login sessions. A device slot is a separate identity — its profileId is not the account's profileId.
en.accounts.register.title: Player sign-up
en.accounts.register.lead: Hand these out to players; no admin login needed. The game registers through the same endpoint, so this is mostly for opening an account for someone new.
en.accounts.sessions.title: Login sessions
en.accounts.sessions.lead: The client mints a fresh ticket on every cold start, so this list is usually long. Clearing it does not sign players out — the long-lived credential lives in remember.json.
en.accounts.sessions.confirmBody: Deletes the current {n} tickets. Players stay signed in, but in-flight requests will fail and retry.
en.accounts.deleteConfirmBody: The account record is removed. The save directory stays on disk (it can be re-attached later), but the account can no longer be used to log in. This cannot be undone.
en.accounts.devices.title: Device slots
en.accounts.devices.lead: Devices are keyed by deviceId and use a different profileId space.
en.accounts.admin.title: Admin password
en.accounts.admin.lead: Changing it immediately signs out the console on every other device; this one is re-issued automatically.
en.accounts.admin.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
en.saves.title: Saves
en.saves.lead: playerprogress files stored on the server. richness is the content score and the guard's criterion: on write, a halved richness or a missing section is rejected.
en.saves.richnessHint: richness = item pairs + track records + achievements + tutorials, plus bonuses for missions/statistics. A drop usually means half the save failed to upload.
en.saves.versionHint: Granting items works by bumping this: the client only shows the progress-conflict screen when remote ≠ local, so the player can pick “use cloud”.
en.saves.historyLead: Rolling back promotes a snapshot to latest.json. A restore point is written first, so a rollback can itself be undone.
en.saves.rollbackConfirmBody: The current latest.json (richness {rich}) is replaced by this one (richness {new}). A restore point is written first and can be undone from the toast that follows.
en.saves.noHistory: This save slot has no snapshots yet.
en.saves.noBalances: No readable items2 in this save.
en.grant.title: Grant items
en.grant.lead: Two kinds of grant. Arena balances (golden tickets, chips) live on the server, so the player sees them the next time they open the arena — nothing for them to do. Save items are written into the save file and only arrive if the player picks “use cloud” in-game.
en.grant.saveTitle: Save items · player must pick “use cloud”
en.grant.list.unverified: Unverified: the save layout for these was never confirmed on a device, and their ids share a key range with bike parts, so writing them may do nothing.
en.grant.whitelist: The list comes from the game's own item table (477 entries: currency / consumables / parts / outfits / blueprints / tracks; paints have their own card). Currency, consumables and parts are counters in the save ("add N" is +N); outfits are listed by set and ticking one unlocks helmet / upper / lower together; outfit parts and blueprints are 0/1 flags, so they take no amount. Tracks have no on-device evidence yet and are marked Unverified. PVP golden tickets have no save entry — use the arena card above.
en.grant.list.derived: Outfits are listed by set (80 sets, taken from the game's own table): ticking one unlocks its helmet / upper / lower together. Sets marked Hidden were never sold — their part ids appear in no config and are derived from the set table.
en.grant.list.paintHint: Paints are grouped by bike (108 of them, from the game's own bikes.txt): a save stores only one entry per bike — the low 24 bits are a bitmask of which paints that bike owns, the high 8 bits are the one currently fitted. Ticking a paint sets its bit; the paint's own id never goes into the save.
en.grant.list.bpHint: Blueprints are piece counters, listed per bike (12 of the 19 bikes have piece ids, taken from the game's own upgrades.txt): each bike needs a different number of pieces, and ticking one pre-fills how many are still missing. The other 7 bikes ({names}) have no piece ids at all — they can only be bought with coins, nothing is missing here.
en.grant.modeHint: Add / set applies to counters only (currency, consumables, parts)
en.grant.pvpLead: Golden tickets and chips live in the server's pvp_state.json. The client only ever sends deltas (“spend one”, “add N”), never a whole balance, so a change here takes effect at once and is never overwritten.
en.grant.pvpNever: No arena ranking record for this save slot yet; tickets start from the server default.
en.grant.warnTitle: Editing the save is not enough for the client to accept it
en.grant.warnBody: We bump the save version. The next sync finds the mismatch and shows the progress-conflict dialog — only if the player picks “use cloud” do the items arrive. Picking local overwrites the grant. This is not instant; tell the player which button to press.
en.grant.warnBody2: Measured on a real device: on a cold start the client asks for the server's version and then pushes its own local save anyway, without ever showing the dialog — the grant is erased on the spot. So save grants are not guaranteed to arrive. Use the arena card above for golden tickets and chips.
en.grant.noSave: This save slot cannot be read — try another one
en.msg.authRequired: Admin sign-in required — returning to the login page…
en.weekly.lead: The Midnight Cup is a weekly time trial: players run one track, the server ranks them and pays out. This screen edits the server's weekly block; changes take effect on save, with no restart and nothing for players to do.
en.weekly.now.title: Right now
en.weekly.now.warn: Attempt counts live in server memory only: restart the server and everybody's tries for this week come back full. To really roll over, use “End this week now” below.
en.weekly.now.noPlayers: Nobody has raced this week yet.
en.weekly.f.daysHint: Changing the length moves the week number, so everyone's tries start over.
en.weekly.f.offsetHint: Relative to the server's real week. To end this week for real, use the red button below.
en.weekly.time.title: Timing
en.weekly.time.hint: The Midnight Cup has no match duration — it is a single time-trial run, timed by the client's own table.
en.weekly.time.resetBody: Everyone's tries for this week reset right away and the board restarts next week (the current standings pay out nothing). Continue?
en.weekly.time.resetHint: Same as pushing the week number forward by one. Every step lands in the change log, so it can be undone.
en.weekly.rules.title: Challenge rules
en.weekly.rules.retryHint: How many attempts each player gets per week; after that the cooldown applies.
en.weekly.rules.note: Note: the Cup's track timing (time limit, laps) is baked into the client's own table; the server cannot change it and does not show it here.
en.weekly.track.title: Track & opponents
en.weekly.track.unknown: The client's table has no such id — double-check it.
en.weekly.track.noCatalog: No track table in the server catalog yet, so type the id by hand.
en.weekly.track.fakeHint: Adds synthetic opponents so the board looks busy. 0 = real players only. Currently:
en.weekly.track.pctHint: Share of opponents deviating from the base time.
en.weekly.track.note: Both ids come from the client's own tables (an unknown id crashes the client or empties the board). After a change, ask players to leave and re-enter the Cup.
en.weekly.rewards.title: Rewards
en.weekly.rewards.slotsHint: How many pools each tier hands out (1–8).
en.weekly.rewards.how: The server only sends pool ids (1–15); what each pool contains is decided by the client's own reward table. Tap a square to select a pool; a tier can take several, paid out in order.
en.weekly.rewards.reentry: ★ The client reads the reward config once, when entering the Cup: ask players to leave and re-enter — no game restart needed.
en.weekly.templates.title: Templates
en.weekly.templates.currentHint: Read-only. Saving a template snapshots this whole page of settings on the server.
en.weekly.templates.name: Template name
en.weekly.templates.saveHint: Saves the values in effect right now, not unsaved edits above.
en.weekly.templates.deleteBody: Delete template “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
en.bunker.lead: The Bunker is the ranked ladder: seasons roll over on their own and higher ranks pay better. This screen edits the server's season, match duration, matchmaking, chips and season rewards — changes apply on save, with nothing for players to do. Rank/star/ticket balances are read-only in the Status card; use the arena card on the Grant items page to hand out currency.
en.bunker.now.noQueue: The queue is empty and nobody is online.
en.bunker.advanceHint: One press moves the whole current season window forward by one round: players settle the old season the next time they open the Bunker and their rank resets. The number clients see does not change (use the display offset above for that). Undo lives in the change log.
en.bunker.advanceBody: This season expires immediately: the next time a player opens the Bunker the old season pays out and ranks reset. The window and the internal season id do not change — the whole thing just moved one round. This can be undone. Continue?
en.bunker.pipeWarn: Must not contain a pipe | — the client only shows what follows the first one.
en.bunker.stars.hint: Cell 1 = rank 1 (highest), cell 25 = lowest; each 0..100. Only affects future promotions.
en.bunker.track.max: A match takes at most {n} tracks
en.bunker.track.empty: The server catalog has no track table yet (the levels block of items.json), so type ids by hand, comma separated.
en.bunker.rewards.special: Special reward (pick or type an id)
en.bunker.rewards.unknown: The client doesn't know this id — it sends one placeholder item instead (Donkey Doughnut)
en.bunker.rewards.subtitle: Amounts are per-rank increments: the client sums the rewards of that rank and above. Coins = item 1, gems = item 2, special = item 145 (its amount holds a RewardID from the client's own table). Only the 43 ids in PVPMatchSpecialRewards work: the 4 crafting tiers, the two bike skins (202 / 203) and the Donkey blueprint (220). Paints, outfits and tracks can NOT be season rewards — grant those from the Items screen instead.
en.bunker.products.title: Bundles (store products)
